summary: Audited 25d774e08..57bb8376c (P3). The ci.yml select/affected design, the sales build-identity change, the Red test quality, the env/service parity, and the scope discipline are correct; the scripts/ci gate reproduces at exit 0 with 130 of 130, and the 4 science ci-gates files pass 40 of 40 under their intended runner. One blocker: the packages Test step narrowing silently drops the test suites of 4 standalone workspace packages. Three Nits: turbo_filters_ok and p3_out_of_scope_paths labels missing from plan evidence, and the strategy does not record the one runner invocation under which the science ci-gates pass.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] review-a: The new packages-job Test step (`pnpm test --filter=science-advantage... --filter=vocabulary-games... --filter=activity-vinext-fixture...`, .github/workflows/ci.yml at 57bb8376c) replaces the old whole-workspace `pnpm test` (= root `turbo run test`). Computed dependency graph at 57bb8376c: 45 workspace packages under apps/ or packages/ hold a test script; the union of the 13 filter roots (10 table apps incl. reading-advantage via the affected matrix, plus the 3 kept apps) covers 42. Four standalone packages with test scripts are covered by no job on a push or a pull request: packages/architecture-enforcement (test: vitest run, about 30 test files; only 1 file runs via the dedicated archive-evidence step), packages/knowledge-space-practice (test builds core and practice, then vitest), packages/mastery-runtime-compat (test: vitest run --maxWorkers=1), packages/reading-advantage-scripts (test: node --test generateArticle.test.js). No workspace package depends on them, so no affected-matrix job ever runs their tests: a change to these packages runs zero tests in CI. The plan (3.2) and the ci.yml comment record only untested_apps=3 (apps, not packages); test-strategy.md M21 treats the 3 apps as the complete gap. Rationale: a silent CI coverage regression that neither the plan nor the strategy records. Suggested fix: add the 4 package filters to the packages Test step, or record the gap as an accepted decision in plan and strategy.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Nit] review-a: The strategy Green gate `turbo_filters_ok=10` (test-strategy.md P3, M14) is not recorded in the plan 3.2 evidence. Review A measured it in this run: all 10 table ids pass `pnpm exec turbo ls --filter=<id>...` with at least 1 package (lines per id: www 5, primary 27, storytime 10, accounting 13, codecamp 25, marketing 23, sales 24, accounts 8, workbooks 20, reading-advantage 25); turbo_filters_ok=10. The fact holds; the labeled line is missing from the plan.

F3 [Nit] review-a: The strategy P3 guard run for the 4 apps/science-advantage/lib/ci-gates/ files does not record the runner invocation, and the guard-table shape (monorepo-root cwd, root runner) fails: 32 failed, 8 passed, because the gate files resolve WORKSPACE_ROOT from process.cwd() plus '..' segments and read /home/daniebo/... (stale since the repo path moved from /home/daniel-bo; not caused by the P3 diff). The intended runner works: from apps/science-advantage with --config vitest.verification.config.ts (what `pnpm verify` runs), the 4 files pass 40 of 40, exit 0. vitest.unit.config.ts and the app default config both exclude lib/ci-gates/**, so a naive invocation finds no test files. The gate text should record the exact invocation so phase-acceptance does not measure 32 failures.

F4 [Nit] review-a: The strategy P3 closeout gate requires the labeled count `p3_out_of_scope_paths=0`. Plan task 3.4 evidence does not write that label. Review A verified the fact itself: every P3 commit (6ba8f6696, 89b8b8e08, b7c8952a6, f0284be4e, e0cf21a1f, acc5f59d2, 57bb8376c; 2cec361da superseded) touches only scripts/ci/**, measure files of the track, .github/workflows/ci.yml, or the 3.3a sales paths, so the count is 0.

Check 1 select job: BASE_SHA = github.event.before || github.event.pull_request.base.sha; HEAD_SHA = github.sha; fetch-depth: 0. Push uses event.before. PR uses base.sha. Zero before (first push of a branch): the 40-zero string is truthy and scripts/ci/affected-apps.mjs resolves it to the merge base with origin/master (script lines about 108-120); origin/master is present because of fetch-depth: 0. Script failure exits 2, fails the select job, and the affected job never starts: fails closed. Force push: event.before keeps the right range; if the old head is unreachable after the rewrite the job fails closed (no silent wrong plan). Matrix shape: ids.map((id) => ({ id })); affected uses fromJSON(needs.select.outputs.matrix) with --filter=${{ matrix.id }}...; the guard if: needs.select.outputs.matrix != '[]' skips an empty plan. CI-04 pins the matrix filter; CI-01a..CI-01g compare the ci plan to the script output as sets per real scratch range; runSelect executes the real select run block, so the output ids equal the script ids by construction and by assertion.

Check 2 coverage: computed the workspace dependency graph from git show 57bb8376c package.json manifests (@reading-advantage/* edges, dependencies and devDependencies). 48 workspace packages, 45 with a test script. Forward closure of the 13 roots covers 42. Uncovered: the 4 packages of F1. Apps lose nothing: 10 table rows run in the affected job when affected (reading-advantage included; CI-01d pins a packages/utils change plans 7 rows including reading-advantage), and the 3 non-table apps run in the always-on packages Test step (untested_apps=3 confirmed: apps/ holds exactly 13 dirs, 10 are table rows).

Check 3 gates: heavy-run 1 (monorepo root, root runner): 4 files, 32 failed, 8 passed, GATES_EXIT=1 (cwd-based path resolution reads /home/daniebo/...). heavy-run 2 (apps/science-advantage, --config vitest.unit.config.ts): No test files found (exclude lib/ci-gates/**). heavy-run 3 (apps/science-advantage, --config vitest.verification.config.ts): 4 files, 40 passed (40), 0 failed, GATES_EXIT=0. Step name 'Test' and regex run:[^\n]*pnpm test match the new ci.yml textually, and phase-13 (21 assertions over the real ci.yml content, including the named gates Build, Lint, Type check, Test, the DATABASE_URL lines, and the pgbouncer image) passes in the 40-test run.

Check 4 services/env parity: the affected job copies the packages job exactly for DATABASE_URL (postgres:5432/science_advantage_test), COMPANY_IDENTITY_TEST_ADMIN_DATABASE_URL (postgres:5432/postgres), the postgres:16-alpine and bitnamilegacy/pgbouncer:1.23.1 services with the same env, ports, and health options, and COMPANY_IDENTITY_TEST_POSTGRES_CONTAINER on the run step. Neither job points an env at pgbouncer:6432 (unchanged from the base). The affected job needs no fetch-depth: 0 (no git-range work) and no git-notes fetch (graph.db checks stay in packages).

Check 5 sales build identity: apps/sales-advantage/cloudbuild-traffic.yaml at e0cf21a1f adds step capture-company-candidate after verify-repair-verify-legacy-rollback and before update-traffic, calling apps/sales-advantage/scripts/capture-sales-cloud-run-tag.sh candidate asia-southeast1-docker.pkg.dev/$PROJECT_ID/sales-advantage/sales-advantage:${_PUSH_BUILD_ID} /workspace/.sales-company-candidate. The script (pre-existing, unchanged) writes ${output_prefix}.revision and fails closed (exit 1) when the tagged URL is unpublished, the tagged revision is not latestCreatedRevision, or the revision image digest differs from the expected image. update-traffic is now a bash step: set -euo pipefail; reads /workspace/.sales-company-candidate.revision via $$-escaped $$(tr -d ...) and runs --to-revisions=$${candidate_revision}=100; no --to-tags; no legacy-rollback record. Cloud Build $$ escapes are correct ($${...} renders to ${...} for bash; F-17's negative-lookbehind regex accepts exactly this form). The push file deploys with --tag=candidate, so a later push that moves the tag makes the capture fail closed. docs/runbooks/traffic-moves.md matches (step order, candidate-not-tag rule, fail-closed note).

Check 6 test meaning: scripts/ci/__tests__/ci-workflow.test.mjs (12 cases) builds real scratch git repos with synthetic workspaces, runs the real affected-apps.mjs and the real select run block, and compares sets; A4 defenses present (changed_files>=1 before an empty plan is accepted; CI-02 asserts guards_found equals 6 and the PR path list non-empty); A3 defenses present (labeled counts ranges_checked, untested_apps, guards_found, pull_request_paths); CI-06 requires ranges_checked>=6. F-19 (cloudbuild-files.test.mjs, lines 466-553) pins 10 labeled checks with a negative mutant (a move text reading the legacy-rollback record must fail moveTargetsCandidate). Red logs record scratch proofs: the good copy passes, the bad copies fail with named check ids.

Check 7 scope and truthfulness: p3_out_of_scope_paths=0 (fact verified per commit; label missing from plan evidence, F4).
